# satellite/tests/fixtures/README.md
#
# Fixture convention
# -------------------
# This directory is reserved for TINY synthetic test fixtures only.
#
# Rules
# -----
# - NO real satellite imagery files in this directory or anywhere in Git.
# - Real satellite data is large (hundreds of MB per scene) and must be
#   downloaded from Copernicus Open Access Hub, AWS Open Data, or similar.
# - All unit tests use in-memory NumPy arrays generated by conftest.py.
# - Integration tests that require real data must be guarded with:
#
#       @pytest.mark.skipif(
#           not os.path.exists(REAL_DATA_PATH),
#           reason="Real satellite data not available"
#       )
#
# Synthetic array sizes used in tests
# -------------------------------------
# Shape: (10, 10) — 100 pixels, sufficient to test all formulas.
# CRS:   EPSG:4326 (WGS-84 geographic coordinates).
# Transform: simple identity-like affine starting at (lon=88.0, lat=27.0)
#            with 0.0001-degree pixel spacing (~11 m at this latitude).
#
# This allows location_id generation and CRS tests to work without any
# external data or internet access.
